question: In which order does MSC 6.00AX emit the COMDEF records of file-scope tentative definitions? Rule: sorted by ((declaration ordinal + K) mod 64, sum of the upper-case name characters mod 256, later declaration first); K = 36 for a file that starts with the variables, and every earlier identifier adds one. Variants: 140 random names; the same after one extra extern (rotation by one); the same declared in reverse order. Declaration order itself is the negative contrast: it differs from every expected order. Names 6 and 70 are reversals of each other (equal checksum, same bucket): the later one is emitted first.
